svg.title: DORA Metrics
svg.desc: DORA Metrics. Measure software delivery by throughput and stability: how often and how fast changes reach production, and how often they fail. Step 1, No shared numbers: January: one big release a month, then a hotfix, and arguments because nobody shares any numbers. Step 2, Five delivery metrics: Change a91f: commit Mon 09:10, live Tue 11:20, lead time 26 h. The logs give the other four metrics. Step 3, Track and improve: Smaller, daily deploys made checkout faster and more stable; the team compares quarter by quarter. Step 4, Gamed and misread: As targets, the numbers get gamed: one change shipped as two deploys, failures filed as maintenance.

g.text: January: one big release a month, then a hotfix, and arguments because nobody shares any numbers.
Change a91f: commit Mon 09:10, live Tue 11:20, lead time 26 h. The logs give the other four metrics.
Smaller, daily deploys made checkout faster and more stable; the team compares quarter by quarter.
As targets, the numbers get gamed: one change shipped as two deploys, failures filed as maintenance.
same work as September, twice the rows
never linked to the release that caused it
deploys that needed a fix at once
unplanned deploys to fix a bug
no baseline, so no way to see a trend
Read from the deploy log and incidents
one service, one month, the same rules every time
Q4 target: 40 deploys a month, fail rate < 5%
team survey: burnout up · 9 night pages
no shared numbers to settle it
